::: {.hero-bio}

I'm a Senior Data Scientist II at CrowdStrike with over 10 years of experience across data science, AI/ML, and engineering. My work spans applied research and translating that research into production capabilities at scale, with a recent focus on LLMs and agentic AI.

I'm also an independent football analytics researcher, applying AI and data science to player evaluation, team performance, and tactical analysis.

## Recent highlights

- **Two U.S. patents granted in 2026.** I’m a co-inventor on CrowdStrike patents for [behavior-based asset classification](https://patents.google.com/patent/US12627700B2/en) and [anomaly detection in cloud logs (PDF)](https://image-ppubs.uspto.gov/dirsearch-public/print/downloadPdf/12726496).
- **September 2026 academy rankings.** I led Training Ground Guru’s study of 89 academies, wrote or co-authored [five articles](projects/training-ground-guru-academy-analysis/index.qmd#the-tgg-series), and taught a [masterclass on the AI-assisted research](projects/training-ground-guru-academy-analysis/index.qmd#inside-the-masterclass).
  - **Coverage and reaction.** [BBC Sport covered the rankings](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvgy8ngm28po), and TGG interviewed academy leaders at [Chelsea](https://trainingground.guru/academy-rankings-success-testament-to-environment-we-have-created-van-der-kraan/), [Cardiff City](https://trainingground.guru/how-cat-two-cardiff-outranked-14-category-one-academies/) and [Reading](https://trainingground.guru/how-reading-finished-12th-in-tgg-academy-rankings-on-lowest-cat-one-budget/).
